description: NaLaZr₂O₆ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Imm2 space group. Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There is one shorter (2.40 Å) and four longer (2.64 Å) Na-O bond lengths. La is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There is one shorter (2.37 Å) and four longer (2.46 Å) La-O bond lengths. Zr is bonded to six O atoms to form corner-sharing ZrO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 26-35°. There are a spread of Zr-O bond distances ranging from 2.10-2.16 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one La, and two equivalent Zr atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two equivalent Zr atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one La and two equivalent Zr atoms.
